title: Roof Leak Dry-Out Duration After Rain
dataSources: Radon readings (`radon:reading`), sump humidity events (`sump:humidity`), HVAC filter telemetry (`hvacfilter:reading`), and roof leak events (`roofleak:event`).
app: Home health telemetry from radon monitors, sump humidity probes, HVAC filter tracking, and roof leak sensors sent to Splunk HEC via MQTT and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=roofleak:event
| search dryout_hr=*
| stats avg(dryout_hr) as avg_dryout_hr perc90(dryout_hr) as p90_dryout_hr count as samples by location_name
| sort 0 - avg_dryout_hr
description: Measures roof leak dry-out duration by location.
value: Dry-out duration helps tell the difference between a splash event and a place that stays wet too long.
implementation: Send the relevant duration field for roof leak dry-out duration to `index=personal` and review both average and p90 latency instead of relying on single examples.
visualization: Table of average and p90 roof leak dry-out duration.
grandmaExplanation: It reminds how long roof leak dry-out duration usually takes, so slowdowns are obvious instead of anecdotal.
